## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new feature or content (theme, sticker, frame)
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `chore` / `refactor` / `perf`

## Checklist

- [ ] The branch starts from an up-to-date `master`
- [ ] `npm run format:check`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass locally
- [ ] The pull request title follows Conventional Commits (`feat: ...`, `fix: ...`)
- [ ] Checked rendered on a phone-sized viewport and on desktop (if the interface changes)
- [ ] New art follows `design/style-guide.md`, and I accept the rights terms in `LICENSE-ASSETS.md`
- [ ] Updated `AGENTS.md` / `README.md` / `docs/` if needed
- [ ] Nothing sends the photo or any personal data off the device
